Autonomous parking scenarios

Each scene places G1 at a workstation: standing 0.75 m from a worktable and facing it, as in a stationary pick-and-place task. The robot starts at its usual spawn at the world origin, facing +x, several metres away; walls or shelving hide G1 from its camera. The mission has to explore, detect G1, localize it, plan a parking pose beside it, park, wait five seconds and drive back. The scenarios only change what stands around G1 and which way G1 faces; the mission, planner and safety checks are the same, and nothing about the scene is given to the mission.

Every image on this page is a capture of the running simulator with the robot at its start: Gazebo images come from temporary camera sensors rendered by the Gazebo server, Isaac images from opt-in view cameras in the Isaac runner, and the robot-camera row from the robot's own camera topic. Results of running the scenarios are on the results page.

A stretcher that belongs to the room stands about 1 m to G1's right
Robot start(0, 0) m, yaw 0 deg: the default spawn of both simulators, so the SLAM map frame is the world frame
Framesforward points from G1 to its table and left to G1's left when it faces the table; objects are placed in that frame, so a scenario has the same layout around G1 in both worlds
